text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, I find myself at an amusement
park to
attend a limited-time event that
Kitasan Black
invited me to.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's a really huge maze, so you're
apparently allowed to guide participants
toward the right
path from outside the
maze!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Also, I heard yesterday that if you
manage to
make it out, you get a medal
commending your
succe—
Bakushin, Bakushiiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? I feel like I know that voice...

Oh no! Another dead end?! This maze is
a real
tough nut to crack!

I won't give up, however! As class
representative,
I, Sakura Bakushin O,
must set an example for
everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! Bakushin O is here for the
maze as well!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O was actually the one who
told me
about the medal! She sure
sounds fired up!

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
Her being fired up is fine and dandy, but
I have to
say, I'm starting to feel a little
worried for her.

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
Do you happen to know her? She's been

wandering around in there since this
morning.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's not good! We have to hurry
and guide
her toward the exit!

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
We've actually tried doing that several
times, but she's so absorbed in running
around that she
doesn't hear anything
we tell her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! I've got this!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Bakushiiin O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Who could be calling me, the
class rep?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's me! Kitasan Black! I'm going to guide
you
toward the exit, so please follow my
instructions!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! I did it! I earned myself a medal
of
commendation!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And you, my dear class rep
aide-in-training, did a
great job helping
me! You get an A+ for your
effort!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Just as the title implies,
she's in training
to take
on the crucial role of aiding the
class rep!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! The thing is, I accompany
Bakushin O on a
lot of outings, and...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! So this is the right path, is it?
Much obliged!
BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! That's the wrong way! Heeey! Is
she out of
earshot already?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
BAKUSHIN O! IT'S NOT THAT WAY!
COME
BACK!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I feel like I just heard Kita calling
me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Bakushiiin O! Your handkerchief! This
girl picked it up
for you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! When did I end up so far away? My
Bakushin
is too incredible!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, it seems like my voice
can
actually reach Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I got assigned as her aide because I'm
apparently
perfect for the role.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Now that you mention it, her voice
does
make me feel kind of nostalgic...
choice_data_list: Does it sound like someone you know?
Maybe it's thanks to enka vocal te...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I feel like I've heard her voice
somewhere
before... but, anyway!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
With Kita by my side, I feel even more
confident in my abilities as class
representative! That's why
I'm counting
on you to keep assisting me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Okay! I've got your back!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right, now that I've shown you how it's
done, it's
your turn to tackle the maze!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class representative, I will personally
guide
you through it! Don't hesitate to
ask me for help!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black and I are able to enjoy the
giant maze thanks to Sakura Bakushin
O's enthusiastic,
occasionally mistaken
directions.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, maybe! Your voice is just so filled
with
genuine enka spirit that it really
resonates with
my Bakushin heart, Kita!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Basically... like this!
choice_data_list: What do you mean by resonate, for ...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: BAKUSHIIIINNN! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that vocal run was incredible!
Hold on, let
me try too...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: BAKUSHIIIINNN! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure if "singing" is the best word
to describe what their voices are doing,
but Kitasan Black and Sakura Bakushin
O look like they're
having fun.
